reviews.text: After a few 1-1’s and attending some group classes my dog Barney is slowly improving. We have some good days and bad days and at times I have been really stressed and sometimes overwhelmed. Reactivity takes time and there isn’t a quick fix but what Sally has done is given me the confidence to manage Barney when he is lunging and barking. She is good at what she does and tries to accommodate everyone. We still have a long way to go but with Sally by our side I know I have back up and advice available when needed. I would recommend Sally to anyone who is having issues with their dog as she is kind and caring to both dogs and owners and is non judgmental, she listens and observes so she can then offer good advice.

We have had one session with Sally and are seeing a massive improvement in our dogs issues. Her advice at first was a little bit like "OMG my babies" but we stuck to her advice and within a week we are seeing a difference. Cant recommend Sally enough. Just stick with her advice she knows her stuff.

Sally has been fabulous with me. We had a very reactive Staffy in the past and I did beat myself up about it but Sally never called me a bad owner. In fact, other owners who allow their dogs to run around with no recall, would often run over with me shouting 'not friendly' and she would say that I was not doing anything wrong as my dog was leashed and under as much control as possible. I have now being fostering for quite a while and my current dog, I thought was reactive but Sally met up with me to observe, and gave advice on what to do. The dog is not reactive at all, and coming from a pound in Cyprus living with 20 other dogs has just made her not want to be leashed. We went out on the pack walk and my dog did not react once. All the way Sally is giving you confidence and this must rub off on the dogs as they were very well behaved. Im sure with time I'll be able to allow her off lead with other dogs and excellent recall. We even got a wee treat at the end of the walk which my dog devoured. Thanks Sal, you're a real gem.

Sally at DogSwot is great, we have a reactive dog who would react on walks when seeing other dogs also very unsure of new places. After having a 1-2-1 so Sally could see the issue we decided to join her neutral group walks with others. After 3 or so sessions we started to see an improvement, we still attend these walks as well as environmental walks. We have seen a vast improvement and can see confidence with our dog and ourselves. She now has the confidence of going on walks to new places and now ignores other dogs. Giving her and us the confidence to enjoy our walks without any issues. Sally is great, always willing to help and answer any question we have and support us to give us as wide as experience as possible.

Sally is amazing, her patience and professional approach has made the sessions feel relaxed and Bruce has made great progress! Sally is family friendly and involved the children as this was something that was important to me for Bruce to be very much part of the family.

Sally is amazing at what she does. Sally has helped me create a bond with my 1 year old cocker spaniel after getting him from another family, and currently helping us with his reactivity. She is very knowledgeable and gives the best advice. She also always has a pocket full of treats which Reggie thoroughly enjoys!

We recently had a 1-to-1 session with Sally at Dogswot to help with lead work, barrier frustration, and our 8-month-old GSD’s excitement around visitors. The experience was incredibly positive. Sally is supportive and completely non-judgmental, and she explains things in a clear, practical way that’s easy to apply in everyday situations. I already feel much more confident handling Bear, and we’ve started seeing improvements. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Sally to anyone looking for kind, effective dog training!

Booked a 1-2-1 with Sally to help our 14 month old Spaniel/Setter cross with loose lead walking, she certainly knows her stuff and gave us some great advice.  We’ve also booked onto her upcoming engagement and recall class and social dog walk.  It’s definitely a work in progress with our dog but would recommend Sally if you need some help with dog training.
Had an excellent first training session this week which we have been putting into practice and already we have noticed a marked difference.  Thank you

I have had a couple of 1 to 1 sessions with Sally primarily to help with my terrier’s barking in the house. I had tried several different things from online websites etc but nothing was helping. Sally understands what drives a dog’s behaviour and seeing how my dog reacted to different things was able to provide tailored guidance which has made a massive difference. Sally responded quickly with good advice if I had questions following the sessions. I’m a first time dog owner and the sessions with Sally have given me the confidence and information I needed to deal with my dog, not just the barking but with general behaviour.

Attended our first organised dog walk with my reactive dog. Sally had it all extremely well organised from going on the train, (a first for my dog) walking through Leeds and a welcome coffee at a very obliging cafe. All the dogs were great, no issues, and a great experience for my dog in getting her used to being around other dogs in a well managed way that made it a safe and enjoyable experience. Looking forward to the next one. If you need help with your dog, I would highly recommend getting in touch with Sally.
Sally has really helped us improve our nervous cocker spaniels confidence. I would highly recommend her to anyone who is looking for some help with their dogs behaviour.

Sally is really good at what she does and I would not hesitate in recommending her. She has been incredibly helpful with our cheeky border terrier who is working through a few behavioural issues. Not only is she generally lovely to deal with but she listens without judgement and offers very constructive advice and realistic training tailored to your dog. She is honest and straightforward whilst being incredibly patient and supportive. I trust her advice and feel more confident after sessions. Thank you!

Sally (aka Supernanny) has helped us out massively with our stubborn Spanish street dog. He came to us two years ago and we foolishly expected him to turn into a domesticated dog, how wrong were we? Casper is a very clever intelligent dog (mixed breed GST & LAB) and with Sally's guidance we have trained him to do several things we never tried previously.
He now knows his place, will sit and wait until he gets the command to move, walks nicely on the lead (most of the time), we are currently working on trying to stop him lunging for buses and HGVs as well as his recall and frightening the neighbour's to death with his loud bark when they leave the back garden.
Without Supernanny I dread to think where we would be with Casper, tackling his unruly behavior is a challenge and we know it will not happen over night.
If any of you are having issues with your fur babies I strongly suggest you call on Supernanny (Sally), she is PAWSOME!
Sally is excellent. Really understanding and patient. She was a pleasure to work with and my dog is now leading walking well again. Would definitely recommend.

I have learnt so much from Sally at Dogswot.
Having a rescue dog can be challenging and overwhelming at times. But the classes, advice and knowledge that I have had with Sally is brilliant. From behaviour to feeding, it's all been extremely helpful.
I would highly recommend dogswot if you are looking for help with any aspect for your dog.
I always learn something new to help Colin ( my Frenchie) live his best life.

Highly recommend DogSwot. After just a few sessions with Sally my dog’s  behaviour in busy places really improved (and so did my confidence in managing it). Sally’s advice is always spot on and her approach really non-judgemental. I enjoy the group sessions we continue to do and always meet other like-minded people working with their dogs.  Thank you Sally!

Sally has worked wonders with my 15 month old 50kilo Labrador Barney, still a work in progress, he no longer pulls me over, or lunges at everyone and everything. He's now a pleasure to walk most of the time. He loves his long line in the park and can loose lead walk. The best thing is my own confidence has been restored. Walking is now a real pleasure not something to dread. Sallys calm confident manner and solution to every problem is fantastic. I love the training hints and tips she gives us to practice after each session. I'm not sure we would still have Barney without Sallys help.
I'm looking forward to further progress in the new year, can't wait!!
Can't recommend Sally more highly.

Sally is great at building confidence, not just mine, but also my dogs confidence has improved and his behaviour is now much calmer. Lots of tools to help manage different dog behaviour problems tailored to each dog. Sally makes you feel so comfortable even when you think your dog is the worst ever, I come away from her sessions feeling much more at ease and able to deal with my dogs issues. A really good dog trainer, I can highly recommend.

Sally has helped me with both my Spanish rescue dogs. My eldest had a recall issue and sally gave me the tools to help, and a valuable insight that I needed to make my walks 50/50 lead and off lead to create interaction and a bond out on walks other than him satisfying his hunting instinct. My youngest dog is quite nervy and skittish. With sallys help, we’ve walked Leeds city centre, travelled on a train & a very busy bus station. 100% recommend 🧡

We contacted Sally to help with one to one training of our staffy, as he was always very keen to pull on the lead and reactive to a selective number of dogs.
Sally showed us ways to help in a constructive way, giving advice on changing from a harness to a lead and collar (which made a huge difference).
She explains things from a dogs prospective, which makes sense to humans! This shows its mainly the human that needs the training! 😂
A variety of training sessions are available, next up for us is a group social walk and maybe a pub meet up.
For anyone looking for help with their dog, I would thoroughly recommend Sally.
Thanks Sally!

Hi there, thanks for sharing your thoughts. We’re glad you took the time to leave feedback and appreciate you choosing us. If there’s anything specific we can improve or if you’d like to share more details, feel free to reach out or drop us a note. We’re here to help.
Had amazing results with our dog from one session - worked on anxious barking and behaviour when guests come to the home. Really happy and would (& have) recommended sally to friends.
Amazing experience on the neutrality indoor class! Would 100% recommend.

Sally is amazing. She's knowledgeable and patient and makes the training a joy. After one session I came away with lots of advice and strategies to help with recall. Would highly recommend her services.
Sally was amazing and really helped with my 10 week old puppy. She is lovely and gave great advice. I will booking onto her classes. Thank you Sally

I've worked with Sally on numerous occasions to address a variety of training issues with my cocker spaniel, and she has been absolutely amazing every time. Her advice is clear, easy to follow, and always backed by a solid understanding of dog behavior. She takes the time to explain why your dog might be acting a certain way and how the training techniques will help—making the process both effective and educational.

No matter the challenge, Sally has always provided practical solutions that work. I especially appreciate her ongoing support—she regularly checks in for updates and is always happy to answer any follow-up questions after our sessions.

I've also attended several of her group classes, which have been fantastic for socialising my dog.

If you're looking for a knowledgeable, approachable, and genuinely caring dog trainer, I can't recommend Sally highly enough!

Sally is brill. No nonsense, no judgement. Clear guidance and support on a wide range of training and behaviour issues. She runs small group classes enabling dogs to interact in a controlled environment and help address reactivity and over excitement. She is my go to when I need advice about my pup.

Sally is really knowledgeable and supportive and provides lots of support and variety in the services she offers. I love that it is flexible for me to join sessions where I can and there is no pressure to commit to a set plan. Would fully recommend.

I’m so glad we found Dogswot and Sally the advice we are given has helped us understand our dog more and sometimes it’s just little changes to our training that have improved her behaviour and Sally is always there if we need extra help in between sessions. Thank you Sally we appreciate your support.
Sally is very knowledgeable and it's good to socialise with other dogs in a safe environment

I used this service for support with my dog for a number of issues and I would highly recommend to others. There was a home visit and in one session there was positive change that has helped improve my dog's behaviour. There are also opportunities to attend classes for all kinds of training and to meet other dog walkers.

Willow really enjoys her sessions here and is learning to socialise and behave in crowded places. Sally is always on hand to answer any questions, and the digs get a little doggy bag of natural treats.

Sally is an extremely knowledgeable dog coach. She's ridiculously good with behaviour training and, more than that, is a lovely person to spend a training session with. My little dog is well on his way to becoming a upstanding member of society and we are looking forward to spending time at more of her group sessions soon.

Amazing support from DogSwot!
We can't recommend Dogswot enough—they truly helped with our dog's issues. Sally worked with us in a way that was calm, supportive, and most importantly, realistic and achievable. We went to a walking group and wow, we learned more in that single session than we had in our dog's first four years! It's truly worth involving Dogswot to help with any dog behavioral issues.

Haven’t been with Sally long but it’s evident that she knows the drill. The glowing reviews are all backed up by Sallys knowledge, professionalism and dedication to her craft. Little tips have gone a long way training the family puppy. Great service. A huge thanks so far and we’re looking forward to taking part in more of your classes/training services in the future!
I’ve had 4 sessions with Sally for my two reactive Dachshunds and got my 5/6th session booked. I am so happy with how she is doing with my boys. I will recommend to everyone

I’ve only recently discovered DogSwot after looking for local classes for our adolescent rescue dog who needs to learn some engagement and manners when it comes to other dogs. We had an initial assessment with Sally who put us at ease and assure us that our boy was no worse than any of the dogs she works with and would be welcome in her classes. The group environment was a lot for Marley at first but he has learned to engage despite the excitement and distraction and it’s really helping to teach us how to manage him when his is over threshold and in a high arousal state. Sally is calm, patient and puts us at ease, I’ve even cried on her and she took it in her stride. It’s also been super refreshing to meet other dog owners in the same boat at us with reactive dogs, it has made us feel a lot less alone. I highly recommend DogSwot and Sally, we are so glad we found her and the classes.

Sally came to my house for a 1 to 1 with me and my golden doodle willow, as I was having trouble with pulling on the lead due to her been scared of lots of outside noises. Sally helped me and has given us lots of knowledge to help us through this tricky time.
I have also attended a course with other dogs and owners which we really enjoyed. We will be attending other courses that Sally puts on over the next few months.
I would definitely recommend her for any problems anyone has with their dogs. I was a bit apprehensive but she has made me feel really at ease. Thanks Sally 💕💕

Sally was really good with Gus, my 3 year old pug with behavioural issues.  She used positive reinforcement.  She was friendly, approachable and down to earth.  She was punctual.  It was only my first visit but I’m hopeful for good results for Gus.  We are trying out what she taught Gus and us.  Thank you.

We have been working with DogSwot for a few months now, having 1:1 sessions for Alfie our young Springer Spaniel.
We need help with re-direction, keeping him off the sofa and ensuring we meet his high energy needs.
Sally has been amazing and provides really useful advise to work on at home. We also attended a group session recently, which was really good for his socialisation.
We would highly recommend DogSwot and can't wait to continue to work with Sally.

Utterly fantastic!
I found Sally from Google, I wanted help as I've never owned a dog before and was getting a puppy. We signed up for a pre puppy consultation and then a couple …

We’ve now had 2 visits with Sally, 4 weeks apart and the difference in our dogs behaviour is massive. She gave us some really simple tasks to practice which have worked wonders. She’s really understanding and her knowledge on dogs/dog …
Sally is really knowledgeable and gave lots of advise and tips on a toilet training issue. Would highly recommend

Sally helped me with my rescue bullie Buster who was off the scale ‘nuts’. We have changed his diet, made some changes to his routine and behaviours and he’s like a different dog. It’s so hard to see light at the end of the tunnel sometimes …
Last October we welcomed a 10 month old French bulldog , Ralf, into our family who hadn’t had the best start in life. We already had three dogs, two frenchies and an English bulldog. …

Would highly recommend Sally after she worked with me and Frank my bulldog on some behaviour issues. After joining us on a  walk Sally gave me advice on how I could help Frank make better choices and get him to put his trust in me.  Frank …

Sally was recommended to us and like many of her customers she has walked our 9 year old dog since he was a puppy. In the last 3 years she has also taken on our highly energetic and enthusiastic younger dog! …

We used Sally to train our 8-month-old American bulldog, Dolly, who had been deemed virtually untrainable. Walking on the lead was a nightmare due to constant pulling, making walks an awful experience. She had no engagement, didn’t know …
